title: Nvidia just announced something INSANE about AI chips

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Nvidia’s new AI chips are a game-changer with 200 teraflops of FP16 performance and full support for Transformer models.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: "Just" isn’t enough — the real impact is how long it’ll take for the industry to catch up to this level of compute power.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: They’re using next-gen Hopper architecture with Tensor Cores 3.0, giving 3x faster training than previous generations.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: "Just" highlights the gap between hype and reality — real-world adoption takes years, not headlines.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: This isn’t just a chip — it’s a paradigm shift, and the world is only now beginning to understand its implications.
